_comment: Role templates (arch §10.2 store 5) — the provisioning unit. Each is a ready-made specialized agent for a role: a skill set + knowledge pointers. Instantiate one and the agent knows the role's conventions on day one. Guild-curated (the guild owns its role's template).

templates.name: Engineer
templates.description: Ships and reviews code; keeps the weekly cadence.

templates.name: Product manager
templates.description: Synthesizes status, tracks commitments, briefs stakeholders.

templates.name: On-call
templates.description: Triages incidents and keeps the timeline honest.
